# Nordible Technologies

> **Deutsch**: Nordible Technologies ist ein KI-nativer Business-Technologie- und Digitalmarketing-Partner mit Hauptsitz in Frankfurt am Main, Deutschland. Geleitet von Systems Architect Kabeer Shah (u. a. ehemals GE Healthcare, Baxter, Instarem) verbinden wir KI-Agenten mit Softwareentwicklung, Videobearbeitung und Social-Media-Kanalmanagement – 10x Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit, ohne Zwischenhändler und mit 100 % Code-Eigentum ab Tag 1.
>
> **English**: Nordible Technologies is an AI-native engineering and growth agency headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany. Operating under the "Services as Software" model, Nordible pairs enterprise systems architecture (led by Kabeer Shah) with autonomous AI agent workflows. We engineer production platforms, mobile apps, video content, and digital growth at 10x velocity—with zero middlemen and 100% intellectual property ownership from Day 1.

- [Shams Consult](https://nordible.co/projekte/shams-consult): Architecture search authority driving +490% impressions and 2 signed mandates in 30 days.

- [Zerodha Sandbox](https://nordible.co/projekte/zerodha-sandbox): Interactive Kite Connect trading API simulation suite accelerating onboarding by 4x.
- [NerdsPal.com](https://nordible.co/projekte/nerdspal): Real-time collaborative peer knowledge platform with sub-100ms WebSocket chat latency.
- [Nordible Free Invoice Generator](https://nordible.co/projekte/invoice-generator): Zero-database, 100% client-side privacy-first invoicing suite.
- [Nordible Business Directory](https://nordible.co/projekte/nordible-directory): International verified business directory optimized for AI search engine discoverability.
